I have felt often as if **money** gives boring and dull-witted people a way of talking endlessly about any topic without needing to know a single goddamned thing about it, after the fashion of #conservatives who regard any non-destructive use of government power (i.e. anything not military or police-state related) as "too expensive". (Racism and bigotry serves a similar purpose: they're universal in a sense because anyone and anything can be reduced to bigoted stereotypes, thus giving racists something they can *always* chatter about.)

#Security seems to be a similarly alluring method in a tech or #programming context. Someone asks a question on a forum about a programming project and now the geeklord who regards it as his duty to shit on all programming questions can respond simply by blithering about "security".
